duration.text: The Business administration at Shenyang Jianzhu University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Application Form for International Students of Shenyang Jianzhu University2. The original or notarized copy of the highest academic degree document (for fresh graduates, a graduation reservation certificate issued by the school must be provided), in both Chinese and English.3. Undergraduate applicants should provide the original or notarized copies of all high school course transcripts, while graduate applicants should provide the original or notarized copies of all undergraduate course transcripts in either Chinese or English.4. The first page of the passport: For overseas applicants, provide the blank page of the passport; for domestic applicants, provide all visa pages and residence permits.5. A recent two-inch bareheaded, white-background ID photo

requirements.text: 1.All non-Chinese nationals who are at least 18 years old, have a high school education or above, hold a foreign passport, are in good physical and mental health, voluntarily abide by Chinese laws and school regulations, and respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people are eligible to apply.2. Meet the admission requirements for international undergraduate students of Shenyang Jianzhu University without taking the written test:3.Applicants for English-taught programs should have an IELTS score of 5.5 or above
